hazlitt-table-talk: Table Talk: Essays on Men and Manners

hazlitt-table-talk.case: Bloom lists Hazlitt's essays and criticism generically; no Hazlitt shelf exists (only his translations of Luther's Table-Talk and Montaigne). The Waller-Glover Collected Works (12 vols) on PG is the complete edition; Table Talk and The Spirit of the Age are the core if one volume is wanted.
hazlitt-table-talk.note: Pick one: the full 12-volume set, or Table Talk + Spirit of the Age + Characters of Shakespeare's Plays (PG 5085) + Lectures on the English Poets (PG 16209).
